method: Manual review of the full company-name list, assisted by narrow rules for explicit legal, domain, industry, and technology cues. This is a subjective difficulty filter, not a claim about company quality or validity.
criteria: Flag unmistakable legal/company suffixes, labs/systems/robotics descriptors, domain-style names, explicit AI and other technical acronyms, and clearly descriptive industry/product phrases.
Flag a few universally recognizable technology companies, not every brand familiar to engineers.
Preserve short ambiguous brands. CamelCase, multiple words, generic cloud/stream terms, and personal familiarity alone do not trigger the flag.
Every record remains in the catalog with a literal boolean TooObvious; only the flag changes.
